name: Arrows
description: A quiver of standard arrows suitable for weapons in the Bow ammunition family. Uses track the individual arrows remaining.
abstraction: A quiver holds 20 arrows. CWN prices ordinary ammunition at 1 credit per projectile and assigns no Encumbrance to any reasonable amount.
provenance: CWN rulebook ordinary-ammunition baseline: 20 arrows at 1 credit per projectile; Advanced Bow reloads one arrow at a time. The 20-arrow quiver is a catalogue packaging convention because CWN specifies no arrow bundle size.
